categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Matches the 'Wallet' label and modifies wallet migration logic in src/wallet/wallet.cpp and wallet migration tests.
categories.rationale: Fixes a failure and unhandled std::bad_function_call exception during legacy-to-descriptor wallet migration for wallets with watch-only transactions and no private keys (issue #36483). Migration correctness across the legacy-to-descriptor path is high priority for wallet users, though this affects a specific subset of legacy wallets.
